Metro Time Helper: Taipei MRT

Tell it when to arrive. It tells you when to leave.

A Taipei MRT time planner for iPhone. Pick your stations and the time you need to be there, and it works backward to the latest time you should enter the station, transfers included.

What it does

  • Plan backward from your arrival time

    Choose where you are, where you are going, and when you need to arrive. You get the latest time to walk through the gates, a step-by-step timeline with each transfer, first and last train warnings, and an optional leave-now reminder. Prefer to go right away? Switch to Leave now and see when you will arrive.

  • Xiaobitan Branch, done properly

    The Qizhang to Xiaobitan shuttle runs only every 12 to 16 minutes or so, and most route apps gloss over it. Here you get the official fixed timetable, a countdown to the next train, full today, weekday and weekend schedules, the original timetable PDF, and an alert 1 to 30 minutes before departure.

  • Beitou to Xinbeitou, for the hot springs

    The short branch to the Xinbeitou hot spring area gets the same treatment: the official fixed timetable in both directions, a live countdown, and a departure alert. When a planned trip uses either branch, the planner uses the fixed timetable too.

  • A map you can tap, and a widget

    Pinch and zoom the built-in MRT map and tap any station to set it as your start or destination; your route is drawn right on the map. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show the next train in both directions on the branch you choose.

  • Private by design

    No account and no sign-up. No ads, no third-party analytics, and no personal data collected. Every calculation runs on your iPhone, and reminders are scheduled locally on the device.

  • Try everything for 24 hours

    Download the app and start a 24-hour trial with every feature unlocked. After that, a single one-time purchase keeps everything for good. There is no subscription, and nothing renews.

Contact us

Questions, a timetable that looks wrong, or an idea for the app? Write to us. Mentioning your iPhone model, iOS version, the app version (shown in Settings), and the stations involved helps us look into it faster.
